searchText: What is the value in testing pre-merge network? On Prysm, we are discussing removing some code specific to block production and other validator actions in older forks. Block processing is still maintained for all forks testing the pre-merge history expiry / retreival systems was the main thing that came to mind We need to be able at most to re-execute pre-merge blocks. Consensus and production does not seem useful.
